movie_title: Do consumers care about carbon footprints? - 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes! Are you concerned about your carb

vocabulary.definition: the amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds emitted due to the consumption of fossil fuels by a particular person, group, company, etc.
vocabulary.example: Reducing our carbon footprint is essential for combating climate change.

vocabulary.definition: the act of putting labels on products to provide information about their content, ingredients, or environmental impact
vocabulary.example: The labelling of food products helps consumers make informed choices.

vocabulary.definition: measuring the carbon footprint of a product or activity
vocabulary.example: The company conducted a detailed footprinting analysis to assess the environmental impact of their operations.
The new trend of sustainable fashion has really caught on among young consumers.

vocabulary.definition: decisions based on good and accurate information
vocabulary.example: By reading product labels carefully, consumers can make informed choices about their purchases.

vocabulary.definition: trusted or reliable with less environmental impact
vocabulary.example: The company's commitment to using sustainable materials shows that they are a responsible brand.
